intro.summary: Saints Cosmas and Damian were twin Christian martyrs and physicians honored for offering medical care freely and witnessing to Christ unto death.

blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. O glorious martyrs, Saints Cosmas and Damian, physicians of souls and bodies, who during life sought only to do good to all who came to you, hear my humble prayer. You practiced medicine not merely to heal the body but to win souls for Christ. Through your intercession, may I receive health of soul and body, and come to share eternal glory with you in Heaven. You who served God by serving others through your medical skills, who refused payment for your services, and who ultimately gave your lives for your faith in Christ, please hear my petitions,

Help me to imitate your charity, your selflessness, and your unwavering faith. Pray that I may be healed of all illnesses of body and soul according to God’s holy will. Amen. O God, we thank you for the wonderful example of Saints Cosmas and Damian, who served you faithfully even unto death. Through their intercession, grant us health of mind and body, that with pure hearts we may glorify You, the supreme physician and Savior of souls. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saints Cosmas and Damian, pray for us. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
